# FLX-3004: expose schema cannot be compiled into an ordered column set

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The seam needs an ordered, non-empty list of uniquely-named columns: rows travel as arrays aligned to that order (KERNEL-SPEC §8), so a missing schema, an empty one, a column with no name, or two columns that share a name after NFC normalisation leaves no way to place a value. The declaration is refused rather than repaired.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3004
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
